title: RLHF: A comprehensive Survey for Cultural, Multimodal and Low Latency Alignment Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on the NormAd-ETI benchmark to measure overall accuracy in following cultural norms and calculating the performance gap for the worst-case cultural group.
Comparing cross-lingual chat win-rates against baseline models across 23 training languages and 15 unseen languages to assess mitigation of English-centric bias.
Measuring the preference-loss gap between the best- and worst-performing demographic subgroups using the Open-Opinions fairness benchmark.
